additionalRoutingCounterexamples.meaning: C1.1/C1.2 bridge U1.49/U1.47 across the only CORE_LX exit at the unchanged target poses; a .30mm F.Cu route cannot leave the enclosed chip perimeter.

Frozen USB copper plus U4 foreign pads form a closed F.Cu obstacle around VBUS5. Any non-GND via inside that enclosure creates a B.Cu ground-plane void inside the required .90mm USB reference guard. Thus current frozen USB+reference constraints prevent escape to the external VBUS network.
